doc: Sample loot manifest. The loader does not read this file. To use it for your map, copy it to Scripts/<Name>.loot.json, where <Name> is the map's Name in config.lua (Example.loot.json for the example map), or point Map.LootManifest at it. JSON has no comments, so every 'doc' field here is just text and is ignored.

tags.doc: Simplest form: a new tag that borrows a stock donor tag's loot table. loot_points is this tag's own budget. Without table_asset it rolls the donor's table, so its used points are shared with the donor zone.

With your own DataTable, cooked into the map pak. table_asset is the full object path. table_name must match the name of that table in the Tables array of the map's holder actor (BP_<Name>_LootTables_C, or LootHolderClass in config.lua), which keeps the table loaded. While the map is loaded the tag rolls your table; at other times it points back at the donor table.
